blocker.description: S3-P0-01 asserts loadModule('@/lib/match/run-staffing-search').rejects.toBeDefined() — i.e. that the matcher core module FAILS to import. This is a Phase-0 RED-baseline harness-wiring guard whose own description says it is a 'meaningful RED' only WHILE the core is absent. The Phase-3 GREEN goal implements that exact core, so the assertion necessarily inverts. It is mutually exclusive with 13 other tests in the SAME file (S3-P1-02, S3-P3-01..06) that load the same module via loadModule and call .runStaffingSearch, requiring it to RESOLVE. No core implementation can satisfy both. It carries no AC and is not in the binding authored acceptance test (artifacts/02-acceptance-tests/e2e-tests/staffing-matcher.test.ts).
blocker.action_taken: Left S3-P0-01 untouched per the 'do not weaken a test' rule; reported retry_required.
blocker.recommended_reconciliation: Flip S3-P0-01 to assert the core now RESOLVES and exposes runStaffingSearch (post-GREEN 'module present' baseline), or retire it as a spent RED marker. Then the staffing suite is fully GREEN (19/19) and this stage can re-run to success + commit.
